title: नवाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Garuda describes the northern quarter, so called because it saves from sin and leads to the highest good, the home of Kubera, the seven sages and the gods, and offers to show Galava all the directions and the whole earth.
summary.kn: ಪಾಪದಿಂದ ಉದ್ಧರಿಸಿ ಶ್ರೇಯಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಒಯ್ಯುವುದರಿಂದ ಉತ್ತರವೆನಿಸಿದ, ಕುಬೇರ, ಸಪ್ತರ್ಷಿಗಳು, ದೇವತೆಗಳ ನೆಲೆಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರದಿಕ್ಕನ್ನು ಗರುಡನು ವರ್ಣಿಸಿ, ಎಲ್ಲ ದಿಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನೂ ಇಡೀ ಭೂಮಿಯನ್ನೂ ತೋರಿಸುವೆನೆಂದು ಗಾಲವನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: गरुड़ उत्तर दिशा का वर्णन करते हैं, जो पाप से उबारने और परम कल्याण तक ले जाने के कारण उत्तर कहलाती है, जो कुबेर, सप्तर्षियों और देवताओं का निवास है, और गालव को सब दिशाएँ और पूरी पृथ्वी दिखाने का प्रस्ताव करते हैं।
summary.te: పాపం నుండి ఉద్ధరించి శ్రేయస్సుకు చేర్చడం వల్ల ఉత్తరమనిపించుకున్న, కుబేరుడు, సప్తర్షులు, దేవతల నివాసమైన ఉత్తర దిక్కును గరుడుడు వర్ణించి, అన్ని దిక్కులనూ భూమినంతటినీ చూపిస్తానని గాలవునికి చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: பாவத்திலிருந்து கரையேற்றி உயர்ந்த நன்மைக்கு இட்டுச் செல்வதால் உத்தரம் எனப்படும், குபேரன், ஏழு முனிவர்கள், தேவர்களின் உறைவிடமான வடக்குத் திசையைக் கருடன் விவரித்து, எல்லாத் திசைகளையும் பூமி முழுவதையும் காட்டுவதாகக் காலவனிடம் சொல்கிறான்.
summary.ml: പാപത്തിൽനിന്ന് രക്ഷിക്കുകയും ഏറ്റവും ഉന്നതമായ നന്മയിലേക്ക് നയിക്കുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നതിനാൽ ആ പേര് കിട്ടിയ വടക്കൻ ദിക്ക് ഗരുഡൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു; കുബേരന്റെയും സപ്തർഷികളുടെയും ദേവന്മാരുടെയും വാസസ്ഥലമാണത്. എല്ലാ ദിക്കുകളും ഭൂമിയെയും മുഴുവൻ ഗാലവന് കാണിച്ചുതരാമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം വാഗ്ദാനം ചെയ്യുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.109; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: सुपर्ण उवाच

meaning.en: Suparna said:

verses.text:
यस्मादुत्तार्यते पापाद्यस्मान्निःश्रेयसोऽश्नुते ।
तस्मादुत्तारणफलादुत्तरेत्युच्यते बुधैः ॥

meaning.en: Because one is brought across from sin by it and attains the highest good, the wise call it the northern, from the fruit of bringing across.

verses.text:
उत्तरस्य हिरण्यस्य परिवापस्य गालव ।
मार्गः पश्चिमपूर्वाभ्यां दिग्भ्यां वै मध्यमः स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: The road to the north, the golden enclosure, Galava, is said to lie between the western and eastern directions.

verses.text:
अस्यां दिशि वरिष्ठायामुत्तरायां द्विजर्षभ ।
नासौम्यो नाविधेयात्मा नाधर्म्यो वसते जनः ॥

meaning.en: In this best direction, the north, bull among brahmins, no one lives who is unkind, uncontrolled or unrighteous.

verses.text:
अत्र नारायणः कृष्णो जिष्णुश्चैव नरोत्तमः ।
बदर्यामाश्रमपदे तथा ब्रह्मा च शाश्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Here at Badari, in the hermitage, are Narayana, Krishna and Jishnu, the best of men, and the eternal Brahma.

verses.text:
अत्र वै हिमवत्पृष्ठे नित्यमास्ते महेश्वरः ।
अत्र राज्येन विप्राणां चन्द्रमाश्चाभ्यषिच्यत ॥

meaning.en: Here on the back of the Himalaya the great Lord always dwells; here the moon was anointed to rule the brahmins.

verses.text:
अत्र गङ्गां महादेवः पतन्तीं गगनाच्च्युताम् ।
प्रतिगृह्य ददौ लोके मानुषे ब्रह्मवित्तम ॥

meaning.en: Here Mahadeva received the Ganga falling from the sky and gave her to the human world, best of knowers of Brahman.

verses.text:
अत्र देव्या तपस्तप्तं महेश्वरपरीप्सया ।
अत्र कामश्च रोषश्च शैलश्चोमा च संबभुः ॥

meaning.en: Here the Goddess practiced austerity to win the great Lord; here Kama, Rosha, the mountain and Uma were born.

verses.text:
अत्र राक्षसयक्षाणां गन्धर्वाणां च गालव ।
आधिपत्येन कैलासे धनदोऽप्यभिषेचितः ॥

meaning.en: Here, Galava, the giver of wealth, Kubera, was anointed on Kailasa to rule over rakshasas, yakshas and gandharvas.

verses.text:
अत्र चैत्ररथं रम्यमत्र वैखानसाश्रमः ।
अत्र मन्दाकिनी चैव मन्दरश्च द्विजर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Here is the lovely Chaitraratha, and the hermitage of the Vaikhanasas; here are the Mandakini and Mandara, bull among brahmins.

verses.text:
अत्र सौगन्धिकवनं नैरृतैरभिरक्ष्यते ।
शाड्वलं कदलीस्कन्धमत्र संतानका नगाः ॥

meaning.en: Here the grove of Saugandhika is guarded by Nairritas; here are grassy meadows, plantain stalks and the Santanaka trees.

verses.text:
अत्र संयमनित्यानां सिद्धानां स्वैरचारिणाम् ।
विमानान्यनुरूपाणि कामभोग्यानि गालव ॥

meaning.en: Here, Galava, are celestial cars suited to the Siddhas who live in constant self-control and move at will, offering enjoyments as desired.

verses.text:
अत्र ते ऋषयः सप्त देवी चारुन्धती तथा ।
अत्र तिष्ठति वै स्वातिरत्रास्या उदयः स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: Here are the seven sages and the goddess Arundhati; here stands Svati, and here, they say, is her rising.

verses.text:
अत्र यज्ञं समारुह्य ध्रुवं स्थाता पितामहः ।
ज्योतींषि चन्द्रसूर्यौ च परिवर्तन्ति नित्यशः ॥

meaning.en: Here Brahma the grandfather, having mounted the sacrifice, stands firm, and the moon, the sun and the luminaries revolve ever.

verses.text:
अत्र गायन्तिकाद्वारं रक्षन्ति द्विजसत्तमाः ।
धामा नाम महात्मानो मुनयः सत्यवादिनः ॥

meaning.en: Here the best of brahmins guard the gate of the Gayantika: great-souled, truthful sages called Dhamas.

verses.text:
न तेषां ज्ञायते सूतिर्नाकृतिर्न तपश्चितम् ।
परिवर्तसहस्राणि कामभोग्यानि गालव ॥

meaning.en: Their origin is not known, nor their form, nor their austerities; they have thousands of cycles of desired enjoyments, Galava.

verses.text:
यथा यथा प्रविशति तस्मात्परतरं नरः ।
तथा तथा द्विजश्रेष्ठ प्रविलीयति गालव ॥

meaning.en: The farther a man enters beyond that point, the more he dissolves, best of brahmins, Galava.

verses.text:
न तत्केनचिदन्येन गतपूर्वं द्विजर्षभ ।
ऋते नारायणं देवं नरं वा जिष्णुमव्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: No one else has gone there before, bull among brahmins, except the god Narayana, or Nara, the imperishable Jishnu.

verses.text:
अत्र कैलासमित्युक्तं स्थानमैलविलस्य तत् ।
अत्र विद्युत्प्रभा नाम जज्ञिरेऽप्सरसो दश ॥

meaning.en: Here is the place called Kailasa, the abode of Ailavila; here ten apsarases called Vidyutprabha were born.

verses.text:
अत्र विष्णुपदं नाम क्रमता विष्णुना कृतम् ।
त्रिलोकविक्रमे ब्रह्मन्नुत्तरां दिशमाश्रितम् ॥

meaning.en: Here is the Vishnupada, the 'foot of Vishnu', made by Vishnu as he strode; it lies in the northern direction in his stride across the three worlds, brahmin.

verses.text:
अत्र राज्ञा मरुत्तेन यज्ञेनेष्टं द्विजोत्तम ।
उशीरबीजे विप्रर्षे यत्र जाम्बूनदं सरः ॥

meaning.en: Here King Marutta performed his sacrifice, best of brahmins, at Ushirabija, where the golden lake lies.

verses.text:
जीमूतस्यात्र विप्रर्षेरुपतस्थे महात्मनः ।
साक्षाद्धैमवतः पुण्यो विमलः कमलाकरः ॥

meaning.en: Here the holy, spotless lotus-pond of the Himalaya appeared in person to the sage Jimuta of great soul.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणेषु च यत्कृत्स्नं स्वन्तं कृत्वा धनं महत् ।
वव्रे वनं महर्षिः स जैमूतं तद्वनं ततः ॥

meaning.en: After the great sage had given away all his great wealth to brahmins, he chose a forest; so that forest became known as Jaimuta.

verses.text:
अत्र नित्यं दिशापालाः सायं प्रातर्द्विजर्षभ ।
कस्य कार्यं किमिति वै परिक्रोशन्ति गालव ॥

meaning.en: Here the guardians of the directions, morning and evening, call out constantly, bull among brahmins, 'Whose task is it? What is needed?'

verses.text:
एवमेषा द्विजश्रेष्ठ गुणैरन्यैर्दिगुत्तरा ।
उत्तरेति परिख्याता सर्वकर्मसु चोत्तरा ॥

meaning.en: Thus this northern direction, best of brahmins, with its other virtues, is famed as northern and is pre-eminent in all rites.

verses.text:
एता विस्तरशस्तात तव संकीर्तिता दिशः ।
चतस्रः क्रमयोगेन कामाशां गन्तुमिच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: These directions, dear one, I have described to you at length. All four are described in order; where do you wish to go to fulfil your desire?

verses.text:
उद्यतोऽहं द्विजश्रेष्ठ तव दर्शयितुं दिशः ।
पृथिवीं चाखिलां ब्रह्मंस्तस्मादारोह मां द्विज ॥

meaning.en: I am ready, best of brahmins, to show you the directions and the entire earth. So, brahmin, mount me.'
